exam_intro_desc: Modelled on the official BAMF test sheet: 33 questions, 60 minutes, and no feedback until the end.
exam_fact_questions_desc: 30 general questions and 3 about {state}, picked at random and mixed in like on the real sheet.
exam_fact_time_desc: The clock runs like in the real exam. You can turn it off below.
exam_fact_pass_desc: The pass mark depends on the test type you choose.
exam_timer_desc: Off: take as long as you need. Your time is still recorded.
exam_timer_desc_on: On: 60 minutes like the real test. It submits automatically when time is up.
exam_sheets_desc: The BAMF publishes one sample test sheet per test type. This mock exam follows their layout.
exam_cover_rule_questions: You will answer {total} questions. Each question offers four answers, and exactly one of them is correct.
exam_cover_rule_mark: Mark the box in front of the correct answer.
exam_cover_rule_time: You have 60 minutes. When time is up, the exam is submitted automatically.
exam_cover_rule_time_off: The timer is off. Take as long as you need; your time is still recorded.
exam_cover_rule_state: The {count} questions about {state} are mixed in with the general questions, like on the real sheet.
exam_cover_example_hint: On the paper sheet you fill a wrong box completely and cross the new one. Here, a tap on another answer moves the cross.
exam_recent_empty_desc: Your first mock exam shows you where you stand.
exam_exit_desc: Your exam is saved as cancelled with the answers you gave so far. You can start a new one any time.
exam_result_passed_desc: You would have passed the real test. Keep it up!
exam_result_failed_desc: Practice your mistakes and try again. You are getting closer.
exam_result_cancelled_desc: You stopped early. Here is what you answered so far.
exam_topics_desc: Correct answers per topic in this exam.
exam_review_desc: Open a question to compare your answer with the solution.
exam_question_missing: This question is no longer in the catalogue.
exam_review_not_found_desc: This exam is not in your history.
